3f657b95f4.q: What is Aletha Health's strategic shift from direct-to-consumer to B2B distribution?
3f657b95f4.a: Aletha is transitioning from D2C social media advertising to a B2B practitioner-focused model, partnering with physical therapists, chiropractors, and massage therapists to bring Aletha devices into clinical settings. Christine emphasized that to achieve her mission of changing the paradigm of musculoskeletal health education, the company needs to integrate into the infrastructure of healthcare rather than rely solely on short-form social media content, and she is conducting customer development conversations with various practitioners to understand their different needs.
